description: We are Spanish aerospace engineering students passionate about space science, rockets, planets, and satellites. Our goal is to build an app linking Earth, Mars, and Moon locations using real environments for future space mission training. Looking for passionate minds to build something extraordinary. Whether you're an expert or just eager to learn, we've got a helping hand ready for you. Claim your spot on our team!
summary: Project HERA consists on developing an application that allows the identification of different locations recreating similar environments present in mars and the moon (mineralogy and geology, topography, resources utilitation...). This application has been developed with the objective of helping either scientific organizations or any science enthusiast to find real earth places that are capable of simulating some territorial conditions of this extremely dangerous locations.
details:
The project is a tool for locating sites on Earth that are analogous to the terrain of the Moon and Mars, so that tests and experiments can be carried out under similar conditions. It consists of creating a heat map that highlights the places on the planet that best match the selected conditions. The application lets users choose which conditions are required for the test they want to run.

The program behind the tool consists of a series of matrixes. Using data supplied by NASA and other partner resources, every value in each array has been assigned a favorability score related to a given condition.This produces a divided map that represents how similar each point on the planet is to the selected variables. Every condition in the program is backed by a 100x100 matrix that is geographically mapped to the globe, identifying the most suitable locations for that condition. These arrays are added and multiplied according to the chosen conditions until a final matrix is obtained. This final array is finally displayed as a heat map for ease of reading, highlighting the five most favorable points.

The goal of this project is to develop new ways of finding locations that are analogous to the Moon and Mars. With further development and new data sources, more specific variables could be added to filter the map, and the tool could be extended to include other planets. The project is developed entirely in HTML. We hope our tool will become commonly used in academic purposes and research when selecting new environments for practice and testing.
